scope: Selected ordinary 48kHz,1024kbps,one independent substream; transport primitives and observed publication gate. No ordinary codec/audio reproduction is claimed.

units.planner_request: I32 bytes of serialized protected EMDF body, excluding four-byte sync/length prefix.
units.body_length: Positive I16 in native refill interface; scoped maximum3062. Serialized as16 high-bit-first bits.
units.bit_cursor: U16 native frame words and pending bit count; frame_bit_offset=8*(cursor_byte_delta_from_frame_base)+pending_bits.
units.source_and_AU: Local observed frontend call ordinal versus actual caller-visible published-AU ordinal; not absolute ADM or host clocks.

planner_rule: Clear six segment lengths to zero; increment counter and reset to zero only when new counter equals period. Store extra flag. Store enabled=(request>0).
If request<=0 preserve first_block. Return1 for negative residual,0 for zero; counter/flags/cleared segments are already committed.
For positive request choose first_block2 if request<=2040,else1 if request<=2551,else0.
First block has507 body-byte capacity; subsequent blocks511. At block0 only, extra flag!=0 and enabled and counter_after==0 subtract8 bytes from that first capacity.
Assign min(remaining,capacity) to each block until residualzero or all six blocks used. Return1 if residual!=0; no rollback.

capacity_formula.counter_domain: Proved selected period62 with input counter0..61; I32 overflow/out-of-invariant counters not covered.
capacity_formula.empty_body_rule: First-block field may be stale when disabled; do not treat it as an active carrier selector.

capacity_failures.request3063: All six segments populated507,511,511,511,511,511; one byte residual,return1. Counter,enabled,first_block and lengths already changed.
capacity_failures.prefix_request3055: flag1,counter_before61,period62 => counter0; first capacity499 plus five511 totals3054,one residual,return1 with partial mutation.
capacity_failures.writer_on_plan_failure: NOT_RUN in controlled vectors. The native callsite does not check the planner return at this boundary; downstream whole-parent failure behavior is not established.

reservation_rule.present_one_selected: Emit presence bit1 then nine-bit literal skip-byte length. The saved payload cursor follows those10bits. Selected skip length equals body length+4.
reservation_rule.sync_length_payload: Write marker16 bits then body length16 bits at saved first-block cursor, followed by first body segment. Continue raw body bytes at later saved cursors without another marker.
reservation_rule.padding_and_periodic_prefix: The reservation writer can emit a separate8-byte periodic encoder-information prefix and padding. Its full generation is outside this selected block2 capture; planner capacity impact was tested.
reservation_rule.partial_word_flush: Merge pending high bits with existing low bits; controlled vectors compare all544 bytes of each owned block buffer, including untouched bits and guard.

byte_order: Observed output copier mode0 swaps each pair of native frame-storage bytes before caller publication. Other modes not dynamically qualified.
publication_gate: Observed threshold3072 samples, hop1536. If old_progress<threshold+hop, add hop; otherwise retain progress.
Expose internal output bytes only when updated_progress>threshold (strict). First two calls0bytes, next four4096bytes.
Progress saturates at4608 and is a warmup gate accumulator, not an advancing sample clock.
Define published AU ordinal only on actual outer valid_output_bytes>0. Internal parent outputs include two suppressed frames.
controlled_reachability: 2040/2041/2551/2552 are successful real planner+writer calls with typed private state, sufficient non-overlapping owned buffers,return0 and full-buffer replay. They are transport-primitive reachability, not proof that this selected four-payload programme can naturally generate those larger body sizes. Natural bodies are316..422 bytes.
ownership_and_overlap: Controlled multi-block contexts use distinct owned buffers; alias/overlap misuse is not tested and no native overlap validation is claimed. Natural selected case has one active fragment; it exactly fills its reservation and does not overlap the other observed block skip fields.
remaining: Independent model generation/authentication of protected body, separate from transport
